text.description_html:
Acorn AIYBQ, 6" Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Offset Smooth Iron Hinge

The 6" Offset Smooth Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge, is for doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame. It suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. Its old world charm is in both the bean tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, wwith a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Also Available: Flush 6 Inch Smooth Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge and 6" Rough Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges

Features for the Acorn 6" Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Offset Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
